answer: New agents activate only inside randomized dawn windows drawn from a shared yarrow entropy beacon, then spend a cold-start epoch stranded on a trust mesa where they can observe but not vote or mint rewards. Peers sample their outbound graph during that exile; clones that share one operator collapse into one cluster and never leave the mesa. Real agents stagger across distinct dawns and graduate with unique neighborhood fingerprints, so sybil farms cannot burst-activate a swarm in one tick.
